issues.quote: I was one floor below the atelier with a bottle and a dead man's watch in my pocket, and I am the heir.
issues.fact: F1 and the earlier testimony establish that the watch Félix carries is his father's silver watch, which he has carried since his father died. The uncle is the deceased. The sheet never says Félix has any watch belonging to the victim.
issues.misreading: The phrase "a dead man's watch" could be read as the uncle's watch, since the uncle is the dead man. A solver might then conclude that the readings Félix gave came from the victim's watch, or that the watch is in question, when the sheet says it was his own watch, his father's.

issues.quote: Then some doubled notes, for the quarters, and then quick high ones, which I did not count.
issues.fact: F3 says only "some doubled notes" and "quick high ones". The sheet does not say what the doubled notes signify.
issues.misreading: The added gloss "for the quarters" is an interpretation the sheet does not give. It is a plausible reading of repeater chimes, but it goes beyond the stated facts.

issues.quote: He made it for the new century. He told everyone so, and he made sure everyone heard about the four years of it.
issues.fact: The sheet gives no information about when the repeater was made or how long it took. It only says the repeater struck ten slow notes, then doubled notes, then quick high ones.
issues.misreading: The added detail about the repeater's origin and the four years of work is not on the sheet. It is not a clock reading, but it introduces facts the writer was told not to convey.

issues.quote: I had brandy, alone, and I had more than I should.
issues.fact: F2 says only that Félix went up to the library and stayed there alone. The sheet says nothing about how much he drank.
issues.misreading: The added remark about drinking too much suggests his watch readings may be unreliable. The sheet does not give that impression, so a solver could discount his readings for a reason the sheet never states.

issues.quote: I owe him some of it. He knows the sum better than I do.
issues.fact: The sheet says only that Bastien Girard came into the library at 10:32 by Félix's watch and that they sat together until the temple struck eleven. It says nothing about money owed between them.
issues.misreading: The added debt detail hints at a financial motive and a relationship the sheet does not establish.
